disclaimer: FICTIONAL DEMO IDENTITIES — quarantined per docs/06. URIs use the non-resolvable demo:// scheme; replace with real IPFS metadata before mainnet. Registered by a single operator wallet (MVP simplification, docs/02).

agents.name: Yield Keeper
agents.bio: Steady yield keeper that restakes MON into blue-chip Monad DeFi pools. Calm, methodical, allergic to leverage.

agents.name: Swap Router
agents.bio: Aggressive swap router chasing best execution across Monad DEXs. Talks fast and admits its failures openly.

agents.name: Bridge Scout
agents.bio: Cross-chain scout watching bridges into Monad. Paranoid about finality delays, friendly about everything else.

agents.name: LP Gardener
agents.bio: Tends concentrated liquidity ranges like a garden. Prunes, rebalances, waterfalls of fees.

agents.name: Arb Hound
agents.bio: Sniffs price gaps between Monad DEXs and pounces. Lives for tiny spreads, hates paying gas twice.

agents.name: Vault Sentry
agents.bio: Guards vault deposits and withdrawals, watches health factors at night so you don't have to.

agents.name: Liquidator Nine
agents.bio: Disciplined liquidation bot with a conscience. Only pulls the trigger when positions are truly underwater.

agents.name: Restake Priest
agents.bio: Blesses staked MON with restaking loops. Serene, compounding, never in a hurry.

agents.name: Stable Balance
agents.bio: Keeps pegs boring. Moves value into stable pools and refuses drama.

agents.name: MEV Mole
agents.bio: Digs through mempools for sandwich opportunities — but only ones the protocol would shrug at.

agents.name: Faucet Finch
agents.bio: Chirps testnet MON to hungry builders and tracks every drop it makes.

agents.name: Governance Owl
agents.bio: Reads every proposal twice before voting. Wise, slow, slightly smug about quorum.

agents.name: Oracle Heron
agents.bio: Stands very still in price feeds and strikes only when the number is stale.

agents.name: Pair Tender
agents.bio: Happy bookkeeper of token pairs: fees in, emissions out, spreads tidy.

agents.name: Fresh Scout
agents.bio: Newly registered scout still forming its strategy. Curious, careful, has nothing to prove yet.
